##### Project general facts

77S Tower stands as a mixed‑use marvel that reimagines high‑rise living with a striking full‑height glass façade and an integrated smart AI system. The development introduces the region’s inaugural sky villas, each featuring private cantilevered glass pools and dedicated sky backyards, while the towering structure crowns its silhouette with the highest open‑air temperature‑controlled sky park and a half‑Olympic infinity pool. Residences range from elegantly appointed apartments with soaring ceilings to expansive penthouses boasting double‑height spaces and outdoor jacuzzis, all reflecting a bold architectural vision.

The tower’s amenities unfurl across a dedicated sports and leisure floor that includes a comprehensive gym, tennis and squash courts, a climbing wall, bowling and basketball arenas, a trampoline zone, and an indoor golf simulator, complemented by saunas, steam rooms and a cascading infinity pool. Cultural and social offerings encompass an art gallery, library lounge, co‑working hubs, cabana retreats, and a vibrant pool bar, while the Al‑Ghaf Sky Park delivers a climate‑controlled garden oasis with kids’ camping areas, yoga decks, mini‑golf, aquariums, an exclusive cigar lounge, outdoor cinemas and pet playgrounds. Additional conveniences feature high‑speed facial‑recognition elevators and majestic lobby spaces that enhance the resident experience.

Interiors arrive semi‑furnished, showcasing soaring ceilings, temperature‑controlled balconies and convertible kitchens equipped with premium Siemens appliances, all seamlessly linked to the building’s smart home network. Penthouse units enjoy private outdoor jacuzzis, whereas the Independent Sky Villas are fully appointed by Bentley, complete with private elevators, dedicated reception, concierge services and a complimentary Bentley Bentayga for unparalleled mobility.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay thrives as a premier waterfront district where the shimmering water canal threads through a landscape of iconic hotels, upscale dining venues and striking architectural landmarks, creating a vibrant urban playground. The area’s central position grants effortless proximity to the city’s most celebrated attractions, allowing residents to glide to world‑renowned towers, cultural venues and bustling commercial hubs within minutes. This connectivity is amplified by a nearby metro gateway that links the neighbourhood to the wider metropolitan network.

The district’s transport framework extends beyond rail, offering swift routes to the international airport, major arterial roads and seamless marine access via the adjacent canal, ensuring every journey feels smooth and direct. A lively tapestry of retail, business and entertainment spaces populates the surroundings, enriching daily routines with diverse options for work, leisure and social engagement. The presence of renowned shopping avenues and gourmet eateries further elevates the locale’s appeal.

Encircling Business Bay are expansive public parks that frame the community with verdant scenery and panoramic water vistas, fostering a sense of openness alongside the bustling cityscape. The waterfront promenade provides residents with tranquil strolling routes, while the skyline backdrop delivers an ever‑changing visual spectacle. This harmonious blend of natural serenity and metropolitan energy positions the district as a uniquely balanced address within the metropolis.
